pages.text: Three metals give a full set of sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel and hoe. There is no TFMG armor.

$(li)$(item)Steel$(): 1000 uses, mining speed 7.5, mines everything a diamond tool mines, enchantability 12. The best everyday set once the blast furnace runs.$(li)$(item)Aluminium$(): 220 uses, mining speed 6, mines like iron, but enchantability $(item)22$(), much higher than iron. Good for enchanting.

$(li)$(item)Lead$(): 32 uses, mining speed 2, mines like stone. Weak and soft, but the $(item)lead sword poisons$() for 5 seconds and the $(item)lead axe$() for 8 seconds, adding to any poison already there. Each hit costs 2 durability.$(br2)All of them are repaired with their own ingot on an anvil.

$(l)Engine tools$()$(br)The $(item)Screwdriver$() takes parts and cylinders back out of an engine. The $(item)Oil Can$() and $(item)Cooling Fluid Bottle$() carry fluid to engines: see the Engines chapter.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
